''See also: [[Sandviper Kral Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Kral was the twenty-two-year-old heir to the [[Sandviper sect]] and the son of its chief, [[Sandviper Gokren|Gokren]]. Recognized as a [[Highgold]] and often referred to as the young chief due to his significant influence, he was a fit martial artist who projected an imposing and confident leadership style. However, his personality was complex; while he could appear as a charming rogue or a mischievous boy when smiling, he was also known to be arrogant, irritable, lazy, and occasionally cruel. He showed great dedication to the pursuit of [[sacred arts]] but often avoided other forms of labor. In combat, Kral utilized specialized awls that glowed with corrosive [[green madra]], which he wielded like stingers. He was capable of coordinating his sect members into practiced formations and utilizing toxic [[poison]] auras. Despite his status, Kral met a dishonorable end when he was killed by an [[Iron]]-ranked individual who struck him from behind with a hidden weapon. His death brought significant shame to his family and the [[Sandviper sect]], particularly because he was slain by someone of a lower rank. Beyond his martial role, Kral was notable for being the only member of the [[Sandvipers]] to show kindness to [[Jai Long]] and [[Jai Chen]] during their exile, offering them a sense of home.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|The prince is adorned in fine black furs. A green serpent is visible on his arm.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|As the son of the [[Sandviper sect]] chief, Kral serves as the young chief and future leader of the [[Sandvipers]]. He is one of a few individuals who engages in conversation with [[Jai Chen]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Kral is the son of the [[Sandviper sect]] chief. He is connected to [[Jai Long]], who seeks vengeance for him, and [[Jai Chen]], one of the few people Kral speaks with. Additionally, [[Jai Chen]] questions whether [[Lindon]] was responsible for his death.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Kral possesses an [[Iron body]] and has reached the [[Highgold]] level. In combat, he utilizes awls featuring heavy spikes that gleam with green light and crawl with corrosive [[green madra]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|As a member of the [[Sandvipers]], Kral is known as the young chief and the future leader of his people.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c7">''Soulsmith'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9">''Soulsmith'', chapter 9</ref> The prince wears fine black furs and bears a green serpent on his arm.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8">''Soulsmith'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9" /> In combat, he utilizes awls equipped with heavy, gleaming green-light spikes that crawl with corrosive [[green madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c8" /><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9" /> Despite being at the [[Highgold]] level, Kral will never progress past [[Truegold]] without extreme good fortune.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c9" /> The son of the [[Sandviper sect]] chief is a [[Highgold]] with an [[Iron body]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c15">''Soulsmith'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref> Kral was eventually killed by an [[Iron]], whose killer was subsequently taken to the [[Blackflame Empire]] and sheltered by a young [[Underlord]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c19">''Soulsmith'', chapter 19</ref>}}
